description_en: Modifies a dynamic route in your Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 修改当前阿里云账号下动态路由
name: UpdateDynamicRoute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the dynamic route
parameters.name: dynamic_route_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the dynamic route. The name must be 1 to 128 characters long and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 动态路由名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the dynamic route. The description must be 1 to 128 characters long and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), and spaces
parameters.help_zh: 动态路由描述。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和空格
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The status of the dynamic route. Valid values:

Enabled: Enable the route.

Disabled: Disable the route
parameters.help_zh:
动态路由状态。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The route priority. A value of 1 indicates the highest priority. Valid values: 1 to 99
parameters.help_zh: 动态路由优先级。数字1表示优先级最高。取值：1-99
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en: A list of regions supported by the SASE POP cluster access points
parameters.help_zh: SASE的POP集群接入点支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_ids

parameters.help_en:
The application type of the dynamic route. Valid values:

All: All applications.

Application: Application.

Tag: Tag
parameters.help_zh:
动态路由的应用类型。取值：
All：全部应用。
Application：应用。
Tag：标签
parameters.name: application_type

parameters.help_en: A collection of private network access application IDs for the dynamic route. You can specify up to 200 IDs. This parameter is required when ApplicationType is set to Application. Specify either this parameter or TagIds, but not both. Do not specify this parameter when ApplicationType is set to All
parameters.help_zh: 动态路由的应用ID集合。最多可输入200个内网访问应用ID。当ApplicationType为Application时，必填。和TagIds二选一。当ApplicationType为All时，禁止输入
parameters.name: application_ids

parameters.help_en: A collection of private network access tag IDs for the dynamic route. You can specify up to 40 IDs. This parameter is required when ApplicationType is set to Tag. Specify either this parameter or ApplicationIds, but not both. Do not specify this parameter when ApplicationType is set to All
parameters.help_zh: 动态路由的内网访问标签ID集合。最多可输入40个内网访问标签ID。当ApplicationType为Tag时，必填。和ApplicationIds二选一。当ApplicationType为All时，禁止输入
parameters.name: tag_ids

parameters.help_en: The type of the dynamic route. Valid value: connector: leased line
parameters.help_zh: 动态路由类型。取值：connector：自由专线
parameters.name: dynamic_route_type

parameters.help_en:
The next hop instance ID of the dynamic route. To get valid values, see:

[ListConnectors](~~ListConnectors~~): Query connectors in bulk
parameters.help_zh:
动态路由下一跳实例ID。取值来源：
[ListConnectors](~~ListConnectors~~)：批量查询Connector
parameters.name: next_hop

parameters.help_en:
The modification type of the dynamic route. Valid values:

Cover (default): Use the values of RegionIds, ApplicationIds, and TagIds to overwrite the existing regions, private network access application IDs, and private network access tag IDs supported by the SASE POP cluster access points.

Append: Add the values specified in RegionIds, ApplicationIds, and TagIds to the existing regions, private network access application IDs, and private network access tag IDs supported by the SASE POP cluster access points
parameters.help_zh:
动态路由的修改类型。取值：
Cover（默认）：使用RegionIds、ApplicationIds、TagIds、参数的值覆盖原SASE的POP集群接入点支持的地域、内网访问应用ID集合、内网访问标签集合。
Append：在原SASE的POP集群接入点支持的地域、内网访问应用ID集合、内网访问标签集合中分别增加RegionIds、ApplicationIds、TagIds参数中输入的值
parameters.name: modify_type
